recoil: none baked; runtime owns arm offset and rotation

notes: Original normalized artwork is the style reference.
Run uses eight precomposed body frames; limb thickness remains consistent.
Shoulder and elbow drive the gun. Downward aim keeps the upper arm parallel to the torso.
Effects and projectile motion belong to the program.
Left hand supports gun except during reload, throw, and the existing victory gesture.
Melee frame durations preserve swing amplitude with an 80ms windup.
